            });
            open = null;
            // The tag block ended at the CUE-IN, so a DATERANGE id from the previous avail cannot
            // carry over onto the next one. For a normal inter-avail segment the URI line below
            // also clears it; this covers back-to-back breaks with no media URI between CUE-IN
            // and the next CUE-OUT.
            blockBreakId = undefined;
            continue;
        }
        // Count segments (an #EXTINF followed by a URI advances the media sequence).
        const infMatch = trimmed.match(EXTINF);
        if (infMatch) {
            const segDur = Number(infMatch[1]);
            if (open)
                open.measuredDuration += segDur;
            // The URI line follows; advance the sequence when we consume it below.
        }
        else if (trimmed.length > 0 && !trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
            // A media segment URI line — the tag block ended, so a DATERANGE id does not carry over.
            mediaSequence += 1;
            blockBreakId = undefined;
        }
    }
    return avails;
}
